lines.en: I tap on Ayane's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
: Please at least greet me first, Ayane.
: What are you up to right now?
: Sana and I are watching a movie. Do you want to come over and watch it with us?
: I was actually wondering if you'd want to come over to my place instead.
: Oh, of course! I will come over and help fix your oven right away, Sensei!
Is that really the best cover story she could come up with?
: So, now that your oven is fixed, what do you wanna do?
How should I spend my time with Ayane?
